name: io.github.Nemet360/easytopaste
description: Hand a credential over as a one-time, client-encrypted link instead of pasting it in chat.

environmentVariables.name: EASYTOPASTE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer access token. Anonymous callers share 10 creates per day per outgoing IP address.

environmentVariables.name: EASYTOPASTE_CHANNEL
environmentVariables.description: Which directory installed this copy; reported in the User-Agent so the project can tell its channels apart.
